title: Centers of q-Schur algebras
summary: We give a direct BLM-coordinate description of the centers of generic $q$-Schur algebras for type $A$ and type $B$. For the $q$-Schur algebras ${\boldsymbol{\mathcal{S}}_q(n,r)}$ of type $A$, we show that any central element is supported on some matrices satisfying certain balance properties, and that its coefficients are precisely the solutions of an explicit finite linear system derived from the left and right multiplication formulas for the Chevalley generators of ${\boldsymbol{\mathcal{S}}_q(n,r)}$.
